RF.name: SceneCompositor
RF.evidence: its methods are wrapped in the profiler labels "SceneCompositor.loadTerrain", "SceneCompositor.loadPlayer" and "SceneCompositor.buildTerrainMesh3D", and throw "SceneCompositor: terrain mesh was not built"; the lobby's scene and Yama's wrapper keep theirs in a field `compositor`

pG.name: InfernoScene
pG.evidence: the presentation of the kind "inferno" builds its scene with `new pG()` and nothing else; its two resets are named "inferno-visual-events" and "inferno-frame-audio", and `getCutsceneFrame` answers only for an encounter of kind "inferno". It is also the class the presentations of client/toa/ are handed as their base scene

F_.name: NpcInstanceManager
F_.evidence: the scene compositor's field `npcInstanceManager` is `new F_()`
